text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To take part in the amusement park event—
The day had arrived to grant
Mejiro Palmer's little selfish wish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
While being careful not to get caught
by the zombies inside the park—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We just gotta pew-pew 'em with these guns and we're totally good!
Let's survive all the way till time runs out, woohoo!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Getting to play together with horse girls,
what kind of god-tier event is this...!
Who should I hand over my participation fee to, please?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right! Demon King Army!
Annihilate all these zombies with everything you've got, nanodaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There they are, zombies nanoda—!!
Uwooooh, I'm gonna bite you all, nanodaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Tch, wait... okay, I'll draw their aggro,
so finish them off in the meantime!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaah, th-the zombies are
swarming towards us in a huge wave~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, calm down!
...Take good aim and you can do it too, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer instantly covers for the others.
Watching her, it felt like she had been hanging back
and holding herself to a supporting role the entire time.
choice_data_list: Go have fun doing whatever you want!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nuwaah! Suppressing the urge to bite is totally
unacceptable, nanoda! What did we even come here for!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ignite it and blast your soul away!
Demon Hype★God Hype☆Explosion Hunter!
So get on out there, Palmer!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...—Alright, roger that! Leaving it to you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, guiding the zombie party over here!
Let's wipe 'em all out in one shot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Digital, Windy!
I'm charging ahead, so clean up any stragglers for me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyooeeeh...! Palmer-san is always so reliable
and wonderful when supporting everyone, but...!
choice_data_list: She's really full of life right now!
She looks so vibrant right now!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aggro-rush Palmer is also straight-up the absolute most
coolest ever! Waaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew~~ That was so much fun~!
I think I moved around more than in training.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Palmer charging constantly straight ahead
was just as exhilarating as watching your races, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Rushing in with an "explosive assault~~!",
Pal-chin, you were crazy cool!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their lively voices echoed across the nighttime amusement park.
Just as they thoroughly enjoyed themselves and were about to head home—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on a sec, bro.
Why are you trying to leave already?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on a sec, miss.
Why are you trying to leave already?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We're finally getting so hyped up, y'know?
Everyone's together, and we're totally still riding high, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Don't you wanna keep the party going?! Let's play till closing time!
As for curfew, well... if we sprint, we'll make it for sure!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What in the world?!
P-Palmer-san is actively endorsing a night out on the town...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're the one who told me to let loose!
So now that it's come to this, you're sticking with me till the very end!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaay!! That's the spirit!
My fave is totally in the mood, time for a fever night☆★

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Uwaaay...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, which ride next?
Tell me what you all wanna do.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Pal-chin, you're holding back again, aren't ya?
Tell us what you wanna do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? No no, this is just—

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff*.
Big sis, are you really sure I can have your snacks?

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yup! 'Cause more than snacks,
I just wanna have fun together with you!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you, big sis...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...It's not really holding back, y'know.
More like... my nature?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: In the end, whether I'm doing whatever I want or supporting everyone else, both of those are the real "me"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad I got to realize that again.
Really, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: In the end, whether I'm doing whatever I want or supporting everyone else, both of those are the real "me"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, saying it out loud kinda embarrasses me.
Well, here's to continuing to count on you!
